mission_context: Generic maneuvering OTV/500kmSSO;provisional mounts. No provider environment or payloadICD approval inferred.
boundary: Four independently housed passive payloads,2x1U+2x3U,one common reusable receiver. Six fixed-cell concepts have four local feeds and a shared900mm-travel receiver on1600mm rails; indexed drum has four cells and one extraction port. Native custom-material subtotal includes represented storage/capture/transfer/receiver/rail/dock/mount geometry. Full installed boundary additionally requires complete actuators, transmissions, joints, fasteners, sensors, harness and control/power. Unmodeled mass is null.
partial_mass_warning: Custom CAD material subtotal plus catalog hardware OPTION masses. Catalog options are not integrated/qualified. Missing masses remain null;these are not full installed dry mass,CG or inertia. Listed hardware alone is a conditional lower bound IF these exact option quantities are adopted;custom CAD subtotal is not a certified installed lower bound because unresolved intersections and rework can change material.

insert_interface.operating_concept: Each1U has a dedicated passive locator in a3U outer feed package. Locator transfers with1U,remains captive in common receiver during satellite release,and returns to its dedicated cassette;no active onboard insert changer is assumed. This operating concept requires positive lock/return proof.

bounded_lead_correction_R2.guide_bearing_seat_relief: Reopen8mm nominal bearing seat through added guide cheeks;R1 interference16.176779mm3 is retained inR1 evidence and removed only inR2.
not_accepted: Screw/front bearing radial0.25mm clearance remains a modeled support gap;no actual rolling elements,rated bearing,housing or retained axial load path supplied.
Guide end margin1mm at full feed is nominal only;rail retention,loaded deflection and tolerance are unqualified.

component_derating_limits.motor: Published ambient22C data;no vacuum thermal,radiation,launch or mission duty qualification inferred.
component_derating_limits.gearbox: Standard-30..+120C;optionalKL2vacuum1e-5Pa at22C orKL3vacuum1e-9Pa at60C offered;manufacturer warns option ratings may differ. Source efficiency is a maximum,not a guaranteed lower bound.
component_derating_limits.brake: BXW catalog operating-10..+40C;this excludes the full-40..+80C study corners. Static friction torque is not a complete dynamic arrest rating;armature release time is not system response.
component_derating_limits.nut: SB3700 dynamic310N at500rpm,lubricated ambient;conservative155N screen to1000rpm;higher speed unsupported;82C max is not a flight/vacuum rating.
component_derating_limits.controller: MC5005S5A continuous,-40..+85C,60mA standby at24V (RS/CO). Mounting/cooling,phase/DC bus relationship,EMC and space suitability require integration review.
